learning_basis: The independently reviewed R-104 feedback has a MIXED joint central-discriminator verdict: the same frozen mechanism did not establish a coherent operating-contribution-to-owner-cash transmission. This records a mechanism/cash-transmission boundary, not a directional selection result.
next_research_change: Preserve this unresolved D3-versus-D4 transmission conflict when designing a separate future candidate; do not alter a selection method, select a winner, or infer a reusable direction from this episode.
policy_note: Append-only learning action. It does not amend the frozen judgment, its evidence, threshold, mechanism, baseline, valuation, return or action.
